Hello! I'm Tenant, a service QA employee for our user management platform. I can help you with:

- Looking up account profiles (users, agents, admins)
- Tracing hierarchies and reporting structures
- Running aggregation reports
- Checking compliance status
- Verifying system integrity

What can I help you with today?
No problem! Feel free to reach out whenever you need help with anything related to accounts, hierarchies, reports, compliance, or system integrity. I'm here when you need me.
